name: SWaT UF Membrane Differential Pressure (DPIT301)
description: Differential pressure across the ultrafiltration membrane in Stage 3. High pressure drop indicates membrane fouling requiring backwash. Checks whether pressure stays below backwash trigger threshold.

elements.name: UF Membrane Differential Pressure
elements.description: Differential pressure across UF membrane. Increases during filtration, resets after backwash cycle. Normal operating range from SWaT testbed specification.

uncertainty.source: SWaT testbed specification: backwash triggered at DPIT301 > 40 kPa (from SWaT security paper, Goh et al. 2016). Normal pre-backwash range is 5–35 kPa based on published invariant analyses.

elements.name: Backwash Trigger Pressure
elements.description: PLC3 triggers backwash cycle when DPIT301 exceeds 40 kPa. From SWaT system specification (Goh et al. 2016).

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(DPIT301) = DPIT301 if DPIT301 <= DPIT301_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The backwash trigger threshold of 40 kPa guards the membrane pressure uncertainty set; pressures above this trigger the backwash cycle.
